decisions.statement: An artist named widens the fetch to the most candidates before the filtering.
A candidate is given with its track name, its artists, its album and its uri.
An artist named is matched without regard to case.
An artist named is matched against any part of a candidate's artist.
Ten is the most candidates fetched.
A call naming no query is refused.
A call saying no limit gives back five candidates.

definition: the command naming the Spotify tracks a query matches, each with its artists
